purpose: ADR-004 Revision 2 prompt pools (action item 6): Tulu 3's Aya and SciRIFF subsets, each from its own repo at a pinned revision, GSM8K train, OpenCoder's educational_instruct with its tests, and SWE-Swiss whole
note: The pools are git-ignored (data/sft/*.jsonl); this manifest anchors them. Token counts are chars/3.5 over the datasets' own messages; Revision 2 keeps the prompts and has the base write the answers. Every pool passed dsbench's gate at acquisition and the battery gate (decontaminate.py --battery-items data/battery/items) after it; rows below the battery line are kept and counted here.

pools.regen: uv run --with datasets python -m dsbench.sftgen.breadth.acquire --source tulu3_aya --cap-tokens 1000000000 --max-scan 200000 --out-dir <scratch>
uv run --with datasets python -m dsbench.sftgen.breadth.acquire --source tulu3_sciriff --cap-tokens 1000000000 --max-scan 200000 --out-dir <scratch>
uv run --with datasets python -m dsbench.sftgen.breadth.acquire --source gsm8k --cap-tokens 1000000000 --max-scan 10000 --out-dir <scratch>
uv run --with datasets python -m dsbench.sftgen.breadth.acquire --source opencoder_edu --cap-tokens 1000000000 --max-scan 10000 --out-dir <scratch>
pools.note: acquired as breadth_opencoder_edu.jsonl and saved under this name: the Gate-2 pool keeps its own, and it lacks the tests

pools.regen: uv run --with datasets python -m dsbench.sftgen.breadth.acquire --source swe_swiss --cap-tokens 1000000000 --max-scan 20000 --out-dir <scratch>
pools.note: the whole dataset, acquired as breadth_swe_swiss.jsonl and saved under this name: the Gate-2 pool (293 rows, stopped at its token cap) keeps its own. row_ok drops the 64 rows naming a SWE-bench-Verified repo; 7,922 rows are over ADR-001's 8,000-token trace limit
